methylseg.StickyCategoricalMethylSegHMM

class methylseg.StickyCategoricalMethylSegHMM(n_states, random_state=42, n_iter=30, stay_prob=0.99995, emission_mismatch_prob=0.45, transition_prior_strength=50.0, fit_transitions=False)[source]

Bases: MethylSegHMM

make_sticky_transmat(n_states=None, stay_prob=None)[source]

Build a ‘sticky’ transition matrix.

stay_prob controls the diagonal self-transition probability for every state. Remaining mass is shared uniformly across off-diagonal entries.

Parameters:

  • stay_prob (float | None)

ndarray
